uncertain: All 12 values are raster measurements on the embedded JPEG (no numbers are printed in the figure); estimated error +/-0.001 accuracy units (0.35 px), i.e. 0.0015 of the 0.7 axis range.

Agreement with the paper text (p. 11-12): top-3 diagnosis Expert 0.650 / HeartAgent 0.597 and top-3 explanation HeartAgent 0.534 are reproduced within 0.0005. The text gives 0.554 for the Expert top-3 explanation bar, but the bar is drawn at 0.551 (1.1 px lower than 0.554 would be; the other bars of the same panel fit to 0.2 px); the plotted value is recorded. The four relative gains quoted in the text (21.7 %, 26.9 %, 12.3 %, 22.7 %) are reproduced by the measured bars (0.840/0.690, 0.797/0.628, 0.730/0.650, 0.676/0.551).
Series name 'Accuracy' is the y-axis label (there is no legend); x axis has no printed name.

bbox_px was mapped from the native bitmap to the crop through the PDF image placement (54.0-558.0 x 500.66-640.66 pt) and the picture bbox; the crop cuts ~6 px of the bitmap's left edge and ~15 px of its right and bottom edges (rotated tick labels of panel 4 are slightly clipped).
